lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A regular grid of high-luminance, roughly circular pixel clusters located posterior to the branchial region, arranged in distinct horizontal and vertical alignments.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Visible vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity that intersect with the circular high-luminance blobs to form a structured lattice across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient in pixel intensity with specular highlights on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A sparse distribution of approximately 8-10 discrete high-luminance clusters located on the distal and posterior sections of the visible dorsal fin silhouette.
